findings.message: This host did not provide a verified exact author model for the planning review.

The Execution Plan converts the accepted observer approach into one startable, dependency-free slice. It declares one_pull_request with a cohesion rationale (observer, authenticated store and current-input verifier are unusable apart), one slice record with purpose, boundary, present prerequisite list, its own proof obligation, a concrete completion signal, and relies_on_unmerged_successor: no. Step 1 is the highest-risk named RED with its exact fixture, argv, expected failure ("the public CLI cannot produce and verify a complete bounded observation") and wrong-reason repair rule before any production edit, matching the Implementation Plan's named cheapest proving slice (complete-proof scenario paired with the missing-required-assertion control in step 3). The step-4 matrix, step-5 binding and step-9 actual-checkout pilot cover all 12 accepted blocks / 17 compiled cases (R1 4, R2 6, R3 2, R4 4, R5 1) and preserve the accepted approach: shipped fixed profile, detached committed clone, separate authenticated external store, read-only current verification, no nested Vitest parent, no review/closing-gate integration. All five accepted behavior obligations plus decision, data, testing, surface, rollout/rollback, documentation and ownership obligations are owned by the single slice; measurement and migration/erasure are recorded skips matching the accepted Implementation Plan's explicit inapplicability. All four Recorded Decisions are accounted for as unchanged and no new design, API, data or proof boundary is introduced. The Proof specifications table precedes the Delivery Checklist, and every contributor Required proof resolves to a unique real_boundary entry (observer-real-repository, observer-boundaries, observer-distributions, observer-acceptance, observer-docs); the three partial_or_structural rows are supporting only. Current-to-target truthfulness holds: all implementation is declared target work, all proof missing, earlier 257-pass characterization explicitly no…

observer-docs is a review_receipt classified real_boundary. That is defensible here because the documentation obligation is a comprehension/limits claim that no command can exercise, and the targets are the exact README, generated reference and workflow files the plan edits.

Step 9 says packages/cli/scripts/verify-bounded-observation.ts is authored in step 1, while the accepted Implementation Plan's current-truth section states the actual-checkout pilot is already authored but unexecuted. The discrepancy is honest in the conservative direction (it treats the driver as target work with missing proof), but the executor should reconcile whether step 1 authors or revises that existing file.

The feature file carries a feature-level @wip tag and the acceptance invocation filters only on @surface.safeword-cli. Step 5 requires removing this feature's @wip and explicitly checking selection during RED so default @wip filtering cannot produce a false pass; that check is the only thing preventing observer-acceptance from reporting success with zero executed cases, so it must not be dropped during execution.

execution_plan_record.rationale: The fixed observer, authenticated retained evidence and current-input verifier express one useful claim. Shipping any part without the others leaves unusable evidence. This contribution needs no unmerged successor or closing adapter. The slice describes delivery; it grants no PR creation, promotion, merge or release authority.

slices.name: PR 1 — Observe and verify current proof while preserving history
slices.purpose: Let the Safeword Maintainer obtain trustworthy execution-only proof and recover from failed attempts.
slices.boundary: Two proof CLI leaves, fixed T3E4NS profile, isolated runner, private immutable evidence, verifier, acceptance/verification and generated distributions/docs. Exclude certification/closing, shared review or closing gates, historical rewrites, stale #5857 integration, paid qualification, live providers, host enrollment, cloud/OpenCode recovery and shared cache/runtime replacement.
slices.proof: Node/Cucumber parents exercise the actual CLI, Git, fixed runner, store and verification. Pure matrices use a separate Vitest run. A final standalone run must succeed on the actual clean committed checkout.
slices.completion_signal: All accepted behavior and named matrices pass, actual-checkout observation and verification succeed, generated entrypoints agree, and all protected original bytes and 33 deferred identities/owners remain unchanged and uncredited.
